question: With what attitude should one protect the designated sacrificial being?
premises: A mother protects her own son.
The son may be born from a lover.
This protection serves as the model for conduct.
inference: One should protect the designated being just as a mother protects her own son even if born from a lover.
uncertainties: The application of the simile to the ritual context is implicit.
plain_english: One should protect him just as a mother protects her own son born from her lover.
